newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU unemployment unchanged at 10.8 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: EU unemployment unchanged at 10.8 pct in January.

text.p: Unemployment in the 15-nation European Union was flat at 10.8 percent in January compared with a year earlier, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office, said on Thursday.

The EU agency said the apparent lack of change was due to compensating factors. For example, sharp rises in the number of those without work in Germany, Sweden and France were offset by greater employment growth in most other countries.
Eurostat found that the jobless rate was highest in Spain at 21.6 percent and lowest in Luxembourg at 3.4 percent.
January figures were unavailable for Denmark, the Netherlands, Italy, Finland and Greece.

Youth unemployment remained high, with a rate of 40.7 percent for men and women under 25 years old in Spain. Overall, the youth rate was 21.3 percent for the bloc, off slightly from 21.9 percent a year earlier.
Differences were also seen in the unemployment rate for men and women.
The jobless rate for women was 12.4 percent in January compared with 12.6 percent a year ago. For men during the same period there was a slight increase to 9.6 percent from 9.5 percent.
*No figures for Denmark, the Netherlands, Italy, Finland and Greece.
